classification: Read-only serial entry source-boundary check; no build, deployment or hardware access
initial_expectation: Expected SDK edits to reject the frozen entry; that assumption was incorrect
meaning: cold_profile.entry checks the wrapper sources, image hash, layout and fixed serial profile, not all upstream SDK source files. A frozen old serial payload remains identifiable and admissible; it supplies no evidence that this new SD session code is running.
next_gate: Build a new native payload and entry under an explicit controlled-SD profile; independently verify the selected SDK source receipt and exact payload/hash/profile through the matched boot chain.
